caption: The drawing depicts a single dark-colored jug or pitcher with a glossy, reflective black surface. The jug has a rotund body with decorative swirls embossed on its main section, a wide, rounded spout, and a prominent handle attached at the top and bottom of the jug’s body. The neck of the jug is ribbed with horizontal lines and the jug sits on a small, circular pedestal base. The background is plain, off-white or beige with slight discoloration and no additional objects or designs present. The drawing uses shading and highlights to emphasize the reflective and curved surfaces of the jug, with light reflections suggesting a smooth, polished finish.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
